title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Cabalic, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Cabalic National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Barangay Cabalic, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, To Be Known As the Cabalic National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Cabalic, Thị trấn Balasan, Tỉnh Iloilo được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Cabalic
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cabalic, เทศบาล Balasan, จังหวัด Iloilo ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Cabalic
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Cabalic, Kotamadya Balasan, Provinsi Iloilo dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Cabalic
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Cabalic, Perbandaran Balasan, Wilayah Iloilo dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Cabalic

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in Barangay Cabalic, Municipality of Balasan, Province of Iloilo, to be known as the Cabalic National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
